program_sflash_assets.description: Indicates whether to program the assets which are placed into SFLASH

program_hash.description: Enables ASSET_HASH and FACTORY_HASH validation in DEVELOPMENT LCS

nv_counter_a1.description: NV counter slot 1. 0, if no update

nv_counter_a2.description: NV counter slot 2. 0, if no update

failed_signature_counter.comment_1: If a counter value is 0, a signature check is not performed, but a signature is treated as failed.
failed_signature_counter.comment_2: If a counter value is 1 to 65534, a signature is checked, and if a signature check fails then decrease a counter
failed_signature_counter.comment_3: If a counter value is 65535, the counter is ignored, but a signature is checked each time

ram_app.description: Failed signature counter for RAM application

boot_app_layout_0.description: Failed signature counter for application in BOOT_APP_LAYOUT[0] slot

boot_app_layout_1.description: Failed signature counter for application in BOOT_APP_LAYOUT[1] slot

prov_oem_complete.description: Indicates OEM assets are finalized in SFLASH
prov_oem_complete.warning: Once the 'prov_oem_complete' parameter value is set to true, it cannot be changed! No further updates to SFLASH are allowed

ap_cm33.description: Configures the CM33 debug access port availability in the PRODUCTION and DEVELOPMENT LCS

listen_window.description: Configures the listen window time to acquire the CM33 debug access port in the PRODUCTION LCS (in milliseconds). Valid range: 0-127

cm33_dbg.description: Configures the invasive debug of CM33 core

cm33_nid.description: Configures the non-invasive debug of CM33 core

cm33_spid.description: Configures the secure privileged invasive debug of CM33 core

cm33_spnid.description: Configures the secure privileged non-invasive debug of CM33 core

cm33_secure.description: Enables the CM33 secure AP interface

ap.description: Configures the System debug access port availability in the PRODUCTION and DEVELOPMENT LCS

secure.description: Enables the system secure AP interface

mmio_restrictions.applicable_conf: No restrictions, SRSS_GENERAL2 only, No access

debug_pins.comment_5: 1001 - SWJ pins disabled, JTAG is enabled
debug_pins.comment_6: 1010 - SWJ pins disabled, JTAG is disabled

boot_bank_ctr_offset.description: An offset from the start of each flash bank where a 32-bit counter for flash dual bank switching is placed

boot_hash_locking.description: Enable hash locking, fast authentication (compare a hash) instead of ECDSA

boot_auth_images.description: Configures the images authentication and moving from a SSS after DFU update
boot_auth_images.comment_2: ONE - Authenticate the first image, ignore the other images
boot_auth_images.comment_4: ALL_MOVE - Authenticate all images, move from SSS on a successful DFU update

boot_app_layout.description: The memory layout for the applications defined by BOOT_CFG_ID. 0x32000000 - 0x33FFFFFF for secure addresses; 0x22000000 - 0x23FFFFFF for non-secure addresses

dfu_enable.description: Indicates whether Device Firmware Update is enabled

alternate_port.description: Alternate DFU interface port number (0, 1, ..., 13), 0 for single-port SCBs

dfu_en_pin.description: DFU enable pin. Format: Px_y, where x is port number (0, 1, ..., 13) and y is pin number (0, 1, ..., 7)

rx.description: RX pin. num is the pin number (0-7); alternate_port is false for the primary port or true for the alternate port

tx.description: TX pin. num is the pin number (0-7); alternate_port is false for the primary port or true for the alternate port

mosi.description: MOSI pin. num is the pin number (0-7); alternate_port is false for the primary port or true for the alternate port

miso.description: MISO pin. num is the pin number (0-7); alternate_port is false for the primary port or true for the alternate port

clk.description: CLK pin. num is the pin number (0-7); alternate_port is false for the primary port or true for the alternate port

nss.description: NSS pin. num is the pin number (0-7); alternate_port is false for the primary port or true for the alternate port

sda.description: SDA pin. num is the pin number (0-7); alternate_port is false for the primary port or true for the alternate port

scl.description: SCL pin. num is the pin number (0-7); alternate_port is false for the primary port or true for the alternate port

nonce.description: Hex string or path to a binary file containing nonce for revocation of IFX_ROT_KEY_0 or IFX_RMA_MASTER_KEY_0

ifx_revocation_signature.description: Hex string or binary file containing IFX_REVOCATION_SIGNATURE for revocation of IFX_ROT_KEY_0 or IFX_RMA_MASTER_KEY_0

pc2_handler.description: Used to switch to PC2 when it is a 'Special' PC

pc3_handler.description: Used to switch to PC3 when it is a 'Special' PC

boundary_scan.description: Indicates whether Boundary Scan is enabled

disable_ramapp.description: Indicates whether RAM application execution is disabled

mpc_struct_flash.description: Flash MPC structures. The total number of RAM and Flash MPC structures must be less than 32

value.description: Offset and size in KB. The values must be multiple of 2 (e.g. 0 KB, 2 KB, 4 KB, 8 KB, ...)

attr.description: The MPC attributes for this memory region
attr.comment_1: WRN allow read, write, and NS only access
attr.comment_4: WR- read and write access, but NS=0 only

oem_debug_public_key.description: Path to the OEM debug public key

oem_enc_key.description: Path to the DFU OEM encryption key (256-bit)

raw_data_pc012.description: Path to a binary file containing custom data accessible in PC0, PC1, and PC2. Up to 84 bytes
